Players had a strong defence, but too many contact/obstruction penalties cost us. Need to improve footwork, discipline, endurance and court vision.

The players were exceptional from the first to the last whistle. They started getting tired during the 3rd quarter since they had no subs, but they pushed harder during the last quarter of the game. I loved how disciplined and respectful they were during the game and listened to the umpires call each time without hesitation. It was amazing to watch them give it their all despite the fatigue.

Players were a bit intimidated in the first half of the game, the opposing team set the tone, dominating during the first half, and kept momentum. Players took over the game, there was better control, communication and minimum fouls. Overall, they played really well!
Good team just the same they also need to work on ball skills e.g passing, tapping, kicking and controlling. Then introduce tackling and marking.

Despite the loss my team played very well however I need to strengthen the defense, they tend to day dream at the goal post also we need to work on communication and not being afraid of the opponent they must go and get the ball also they must work on stopping the ball and playing it immediately

Great defence from my B team they definitely listened on marking a player most of the kids on this team is new to the sport so we have to work on not scoring an own goal, running while looking up and see who you hitting to, communicate also not everyone has to be at the goal post they need to spread out more

The boys held most of the possession and they controlled the pace of the game which allowed them to make more penetrative passes towards the opposition side, creating more chances which they converted into goals. It was an amazing performance from the boys, only issue they encountered was defending counter attacks. They couldnt seem to track back fast enough and they left the goalkeeper isolated and they conceded 2 goals

Overall both teams started off strong during the u11 game we gave away possession too easily and we didnt follow through with our tackles towards the second half they were very tired and it shows we need to work on our fitness. U13s game was excellent overall good work from the boys, holding possession and good counter attacking football we need to work on our fitness as well as confidence this will help us convert our chances

Solid 90 minutes and a deserved 2-0 win. We executed the game plan, stayed disciplined and managed the game well from start to finish. We kept a clean sheet against a good Lion Fountain side. Both goals came from patterns we've drilled. Areas of improvement: Final Ball, Def/Att Set-Pieces.

The boys had a bright start early into the game and we took control and had 4 opportunities in the first few minutes. Unfortunately we weren't able to put them away which later costed us. With the boys being so heavy on attack, it left them exposed at the back and the opposition were able to capitalize on this during their counter attack. The boys kept fighting and kept knocking on the door and were eventually rewarded with a goal. Unfortunately that was all the boys could do as they were exhausted by the end

Game was quite a bit stressful but we manage to come back second half from 2-0 down receiving two penalties and recovering from our first half mistake made us come back and we still have a few things to work on like eye coordination, first touch control and movements on the field during game situations.
the boys fought, tried their best however it was a difficult game to play. The ref had many calls which i feel like he was unfair, favouring more of his team and for both A and the B team.

Tough day at the office for the u9 side. Conceded 5 goals in the first half, which then made it difficult for them to come back in the second half. They showed good fight even though the results did not go their way.
Lots of improvement left. Ball control, Heading, Shooting, Passing, Building confidence and team moral

Our team consisted of 8-10 first time to Grassroot ability players, also the wet pitch conditions really exposed us during the first half, where we conceded most (3 goals). I was able to adjust the teams formation and encourage the players to be more aggressive when competing for the ball in 50/50 challenges for second half. Man Of The Match: Goalkeeper, Advia, superb performance which got him promoted to the U/13 A.

result: U/10 A lost 2 -1 then B lost 3 - 1
feedback: Much better than last week. A lot of improvement to the players they show intent today and a bit of fighting. Still need to fix a few things again at training, shooting drills a lot.
The girls played well, we still have a lot to work on but now I see exactly what we need to work on!

The boy's played well showed heart even though we still lacking in a few positions it's something we will have to work on along the way. Overall good home performance very dominant display hope to continue with the strong performance

First half the game started off a little rocky. Second half, the girls played so well and communicated with each other nicely - Still little things we need to fix and tweak at practice to improve match performance. But over all very impressed by the performance shown by the girls today.
We faced a very strong side nonetheless the boys tried. We have to work more on our midfield fitness and concentration and be more aggressive
Actually a really well fought match from both sides, first match of the season under the belt.
The girls tried their level best but luck was not on their side they let the ball go in moments which were critical.

Great soccer match between both teams, unfortunately Reddhouse happened to be stronger than the opposition. The kids seemed to be having a lot of fun on the park. Great result by the way side on their first match.
The boys played well. Their spacing and passing was excellent. We need to just improve our defence, but overall I'm proud of the team.

The game was heated. The players still need to be taught sportsmanship and behaviour on the court. They also need to be reminded of the netball rules and how to apply them. Overall the girls tried their best but didn't reach our intended goal of the day.

The game was really an eye opener since it was our first match day. We had a bit of a disadvantage since we had only 1 day of practise. The players need a lot of work with understanding the rules and how to apply them also to learn not to take losing to heart. Overall it was an experience to help touch up on the team spirit.

Good effort from the boys however there's still a lot of work to be done in multiple areas of the game, such as, understanding of positions and how to keep structure, fitness, passing patterns and fluidity of said passes. But overall Good effort all round, definitely room for growth and there is potential.
The team played well besides the loss. Their communication was good its just a matter of creating a connecting team so they can use their ball opportunities.

Even though the results werent in our favour the players were brave and showed great attacking spirit today, they took the game to the opposition and didn't hold back. It was wonderful to see them trying new passes and playing as a team. We'll spend the next few trainings working on our defensive positioning and making sure each player stays close to their marker, so we can support one another more effectively. Overall, a really positive performance with lots of effort and good sportsmanship from the whole team.
This was my weaker team, but overall they did well. A few basics we need to refine, but I can see improvement in their skill level.

team: Curro Sagewood U9 boys, team A
feedback: The boys played with heart and passion, they just need a bit more time to train together
The team was comprised of kids that wanted try out, due to the weather that affected us during the previous days. But we should be able to get back going forward.
Improvement in: Positional play, Understanding positions, Passing, shooting and ball control. Basics of football to be taught

Team A- first game without any practice, the boys didn't have a single practice and based on how they played, i think they did well and there's room for improvement which we will get once we get our practice sessions. Team B- these boys were very hungry, they were playing absolutely well.
There is a lot of potential in the team the only thing that needs to understand that football is a team work/sport not individual sport.

team: Curro Sagewood U9 boys, team B
feedback: The boys had a wonderful performance and they won what they deserved

The boys tried their best on the day. Although it was a tough day in the office there were contributing factors. On the day we had 6 of our good players not show up, because they didn't receive letters, we also had 9 players and the other team had a full team.
The girls played amazing despite it being their first match and without practice. Still a lot of work to be done with them, but they have showed commitment.
Great teamwork
Great teamwork
Match cancelled due to bad weather
The boys played well, the bowlers were on fire today. The fielding was also good.
Was a tough day in the office for my boys but they managed to grind out the win
Fielding must improve. Too many drop catches. Bowling must improve. Too many wides. Accuracy must improve

result: Rivonia won by 9 wickets with 12 overs spare
feedback: We won a toss decided to have a bat but we couldn't keep up with Rivonia bowlers. They really bowled superb all of their bowlers more especially the off spin opener who took 4 wickets. Rivonia managed to reach the score quickly with 12 overs spare.

Craighall was a way better and polished side... 5/5 wins for them this season. 58/8 runs put on the board on our side was simply not enough to win... fielding was perfect. Bowling has been at its best but our boys again struggled to hit the 4s and 6s required. Long deep hours of batting fundamentals need to be taught.

Today the girls did not do so well, on the singles match the girls lost all their matches due to less confidence. On the doubles they also lost even though they had a great start but lost focus during their matches.
The boys are now playing cricket, every match they played they take very serious. We managed to bowl the opposition out for 28 runs.

We lost the toss and were sent in to bat first. I was very happy with the batting, I think everyone had greatly improved with the bat and I am super happy with that. We managed to score 56 runs in our 20 overs. When we came on to bowl, we started off well, however we bowled too many no balls which unfortunately lost us the game.
We had no numbers, we had to face 13 players on 6 players thats why we couldnt play so good at all
Very good possible last game. They were finding better passes and making a lot of shots. Way better teamwork, but still room to improve in other aspects

The boys did so well today, they won all their singles with great scores and they had so much fun while playing. They also did well on their doubles, great ground strokes, early preparation and consistency was seen with the boys team
Kids are really playing good cricket, there are some points to work on. But the more we work on it the more it will start showing in the boys.

The boys played very well, but we gave away runs, when we were bowling. Which helped the other team a lot. Also the opposition umpires are bad, they make their own rules and add points, but nevertheless it was good competition.

Today was not our best day, as our players concentration levels got best of them. Lost points carelessly due to poor serves and shoot selection, mainly due to tactical choices and playing to their opponents strengths and terms of play in both our singles and doubles. We look towards fixing these errors in our next training.
The girls played absolutely amazing!!! I'm super proud of them, they have come a long way and I can start to see improvements within the team! First win of the season!!!!!

Even though the result didn't go our way, it was a very good match. A couple of catches needed to be taken to ensure that the results go in our favour but unfortunately that was not the case. Still a lot of room for improvement.

Too many wides and unnecessary extras. Fielding was average, but not the main issue. Credit to the opposition: their batters were clearly well-trained and technically strong. Victory (one of our players) was exceptional - 111 runs, he was Player of the Match, and the only century across both teams. He carried the innings for the second consecutive game. The difference was depth: one player performed at a high level; the rest couldn't match that standard. Major improvement is needed in bowling discipline and batting POWER.

Although we lost, the girls won all their doubles matches which was a great improvement for the girls. The girls did not play so well on the singles as most of the girls did double faults on their serves but overall they improved so much.
I liked the communication in the field. I liked the motivation during our fielding and the running between the wickets was amazing too
There is a lot of focus points for us but our standards have not dropped.
It was a very interesting game for me I liked how the boys Fielded 3 run outs and a fiver for two bowlers. Batting needs to work out more but atleast we ridged 90 runs batted whole 20 overs.

The boys could have had a better game, the boys were not as focused and didnt really have much interest in the game on this particular day but also it was very hot. I think thats why the concentration was not so good, however i believe we can always do better with how they played, because this shows the potential that they have

Opposition - 116/4. Us 101/7. Most runs came through disciplined running and extras rather than boundaries. Inclusive bowling opportunities allowed new bowlers to take wickets and that significantly boosted confidence. The overall improvement was substantial; batting and bowling were more refined, we surpassed 100 runs. We need to focus more on fielding communication and captain-led energy, improving wicketkeeping positioning, and developing greater batting POWER.

The batting has definitely improved, we not losing too many wickets early on and they getting more comfortable with hitting the ball and running between the wickets. The bowling is slowly getting there, again just too many extras given to them, so bowling will be the main focus at practice, however there was a big improvement today
Could not see much as the opposition only scored 22 and we only scored 7 runs where the rest came from wides and No balls

Absolute dominance from the boys, disciplined in both the batting and bowling departments, at the end of their batting innings we stopped them at 54/7, when we got into the batting our opener went wild scoring a couple 4s and 6s, even with 2 wickets taken away from us, our opener led us to the 55 needed to win the game with plenty of overs left to spare, though improvements are still needed in batting communication and bowling composure. Overall strong performance and a good game.

Very tight game, the boys are so willing to play, but just need to work on sharing the ball, and doing so in time. We also don't shoot which could've contributed a lot to our points but it's all positive feedback and things to work on at practice. Otherwise, they've improved so well so far in terms of discipline and respect.
It was a friendly game, I had to attend to the U13's as the matches were at the same time but the boys did well and new boys also got an opportunity to play for the first time today.

I need to work on team morale. They got discouraged by the consistent boundaries and they automatically drop their heads. In terms of performance i am happy. I saw a lot of good bowling and thats emphasis on how hard we worked on our bowling this week. Batting is a bit shaky as we constantly have to rely on 1 batsman to get us the runs but we go back to the drawing board.
The team had a good performance overall, there wasn't much that they could have done with the level of skill we were up against.

We won the toss and chose to bat first. We started off strong and got a couple runs on the board and only lost 1 wicket and retired 2 players. We managed to score 68 in our 20 overs which is big improvement. When we went to bowl we also started off strong and got a wicket. However there were still too many extras bowled which lost us the game.
The behavior was much better, team selection was different, the attitude and teamwork was positive. Another superstar individual performance. 56 runs and 2 wickets from our team captain.

The girls played well, it was a different squad of girls, we need to work on batting well from the beginning I have seen an improvement in their batting but I'm not sure if they nervous in the beginning but we only batted well in the second innings, fielding was good, But regardless they still played well and I'm proud of them!

team: Crawford Int. Sandton Senior Boys B team
feedback: Today's match was tough, as our opponents were a formidable group of players as they showed excellent plays from their technique, to their shoot selections.

They played really well and were able to play better as a team compared to their first game against this school. The main focus was defence which still needs some work, but the team is strong. Just needs more structure in terms of every player attending training so they can learn plays.

This was an amazing game with a lot of excitement from beginning to end. My boys had their ups and downs but they have shown me 2 key points - The willingness to never give up - They can handle pressure

My boys played well. Bowled a lot of dot balls. I liked the delivery variations we used during the match which showed game reading. In terms of batting we couldn't keep our innings going, as it was wicket after wicket but we will work on that. There's light at the end of the tunnel. My boys will get back to winning ways again.

On the girls singles matches today most of our girls had a late preparation on the ball, late contact, most of their first serves were out. In doubles although we lost our girls had a good teamwork but lost due to many force errors meaning most of their balls hit the net or out. Regardless of us losing I think our girls took this loss as a learning experience and they did not give up regardless of their opponents leading in most of the games.
The team didn't bat as well as we should have, we lost a lot of runs due to balls left, it has given me a clear batting line up for the upcoming matches.

We lost the toss and batted first. We started off slow as their bowling was very good. However we stabilized and started to score runs. We were bowled out for 36. Our bowling was very good, not as many extras and everyone was fairly accurate throughout. Our wicket keeper even took a catch which was a big positive. Unfortunately they managed to chase the score down and won with 9 wickets left

Today i believe the boys could have done way better because i know their potentials and they were not as focused as the last match and even though they were not fully in the game they still managed to win.

In observance of the new team I am assigned to, the result was largely influenced by avoidable errors. Batting was reasonably competitive, with good intent and boundary scoring, though consistency can improve. The main issues were bowling discipline and, more significantly, fielding, where a lack of urgency and basic execution led to multiple preventable boundaries and extra runs. While there was a noticeable improvement in focus and effort during the closing stages of the innings, this intensity needs to be maintained throughout the match. Moving forward, priority should be given to improving fielding fundamentals, bowling control, and overall game awareness.
